_meta.notes: Wire protocol configuration for T03P networking gate

protocol_version.notes: Bumped on any breaking wire change. v2 added MUTATION_STATE/MUTATION_SHED; v3 adds MUTATION_LEVEL and mutation levels in MUTATION_STATE; v4 adds SHOP_PURCHASE and the spore balance in INVENTORY_SYNC; v5 adds LEDGER_ENTRY. Must equal PROTOCOL_VERSION in @plant-legacy/shared/protocol.

max_buffered_bytes.notes: Per-socket unsent backlog above which tick broadcasts are skipped until the client catches up

max_messages_per_second.description: Sustained inbound messages allowed per connection per second

message_burst.description: Short inbound burst a connection may spend before the rate limit applies

max_connections_per_ip.description: Open WebSocket connections allowed from one client address before HELLO. Requires ops.trust_proxy to read X-Forwarded-For.

full_grid_min_interval_ms.description: Minimum time between full ~262 KB resource-grid replies to one player

plant_sync_min_interval_ms.description: Minimum time between full visible-plant sync replies to one player

terrain_region_min_interval_ms.description: Minimum time between terrain-region replies to one player

action_rate_per_second.description: Sustained state-changing actions (shop, inventory, drops, mutations) allowed per player per second

action_burst.description: Short state-changing action burst allowed before the sustained rate applies

keyframe_interval_ticks.notes: Full state snapshot interval in ticks

weather_send_rate_hz.notes: Weather/day-night broadcast cadence; day length is minutes, so 2 Hz is smooth and costs 10x less than every tick

socket_heartbeat_ms.notes: Interval between liveness sweeps. Each sweep terminates the sockets that missed the previous ping, so a dead peer costs at most two intervals of broadcast. Was a literal SOCKET_HEARTBEAT_MS in main.ts (E25).

reconnect_window_ms.notes: Reconnect window in milliseconds for plant reclaim
